name.en-US: The Sermons and Conferences of John Tauler
name.pt-BR: Os Sermões e Conferências de João Tauler

description.en-US: The complete cycle of Tauler's sermons for the Church year and for feasts (122 sermons and conferences) in Walter Elliott's English of 1910, translated from the German critical edition and checked against Surius, with Elliott's synopses, introduction and the legendary History and the Interview with the Beggar. Tauler's Middle High German (Vetter 1910) is not yet imported.
description.pt-BR: O ciclo completo dos sermões de Tauler para o ano litúrgico e as festas (122 sermões e conferências), na tradução inglesa de Walter Elliott (1910), com sinopses, introdução e a lendária História de Tauler.

sources.edition: The Sermons and Conferences of John Tauler (Washington: Apostolic Mission House, 1910), translated by Walter Elliott.
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan (research/sourcing/_scripts/tauler_build.py): sermons split at Elliott's 'Synopsis' lines, titles from the table of contents, running heads removed; his asterisk footnotes stay as short paragraphs at their page end. Index and subscriber list not included. Not proofread. The 'History' and the 'Interview with a Beggar' come from the spurious Meisterbuch tradition and are marked as doubtful by Elliott.
